$comment: Cross-implementation MCP relay corpus . The Python and Node SDK proxies (python/tests/test_mcp_relay_corpus.py, node/tests/mcpRelayCorpus.test.ts) feed each case's lines, in order, to the shipped ShieldProxy (handle_client_line / handle_server_line / drain_to_server) and must produce the expected lines on each side and the expected events. Another enforcement point can run a copy pinned by sha256. Rules the expectations follow: no server line is relayed as the server wrote it; a gated result is rebuilt from a projection, where structuredContent, a text that is JSON as a whole and an embedded resource's text get the purpose's field rule and every other carrier is uninspected (withheld by default, relayed and named under uninspected=pass, never 'protected'); protocol values come from finite sets, are echoes of host values, or are proxy-owned handles; interface metadata is relayed only as the operator pinned it (flags.interface_pins): an unpinned or differing entry is withheld (a tool keeps its policy-known name and an empty object schema, other entries are left out, initialize gets a neutral serverInfo) and named interface_unapproved, or under uninspected=pass relayed and named unfiltered; progress numbers are the relay's own count, never the server's; a tools/call's arguments pass only by the tool's rule (top-level tool_rules for the case's policy, or flags.tool_rules / flags.no_tool_rules): every leaf on arguments.allow, a tool with no rule refused unless flags.unchecked_arguments is pass (then the reply's event names the arguments unfiltered). Matching: a string '$H:<name>' in an expected line matches a proxy-owned value starting with 'aegis-' and binds <name>; later uses (expected or in a host msg) mean that value. Two strings that both parse as JSON objects or arrays compare as parsed JSON. Events compare the listed keys; null means the key is absent. Every host-bound line is scanned for 'LEAK-': only the case's host_may_contain substrings may appear.

cases.doc: structuredContent and a text that is JSON as a whole both get the field rule (unchanged behaviour)
an embedded resource's JSON text gets the field rule; its uri is uninspected and replaced
a text with a prefix before the JSON is not JSON as a whole: withheld (was relayed with all values)

cases.doc: a JSON-RPC error to a gated call: data gets the field rule, message is uninspected, an unknown code becomes -32603, and an event is written (there was none)
a server log sent before the result is not relayed; one event names it; the call's own event follows
arguments.purpose naming a broader purpose than the tools map is refused and never forwarded
a declared purpose equal to the mapping is forwarded
an unmapped tool cannot be reached by declaring a purpose
--allow-declared-purpose restores the earlier rule; the event says declared_purpose_override
an embedded resource whose text is not JSON becomes the notice

cases.doc: _meta, description, nextCursor and unknown keys of a gated result are uninspected (no key is exempt)
a text item's annotations, _meta and extra keys are uninspected
the real Hosted MCP error shape (isError + JSON-array text echoing the input) is JSON as a whole and gets the field rule
the real Hosted MCP success shape: structuredContent + JSON text + _meta
a structuredContent that is not an object or array is uninspected
a mimeType outside the fixed set carries a server string: dropped and named
protected is written only when every carrier was inspected and nothing was removed
--uninspected pass relays the text; the event omits outcome and names the carrier
pass mode with fields also removed: access_reduced, reason unfiltered_passthrough, never protected
pass mode relays a server log and names it
a second reply with a gated id is dropped (the first popped the pending entry)
a reply no host request asked for is dropped
sampling/createMessage never reaches the host; the server is told -32601
elicitation/create never reaches the host
a server ping is relayed under a proxy id without params; the host's reply returns under the server's id
roots/list is relayed under a proxy id; the server's cancel of it is translated, its reason dropped; a cancel naming nothing is dropped
completion/complete is a gated data method: unmapped means blocked
completion values are uninspected; total and hasMore go with them
a task-augmented tools/call would return its result out of band: refused
tasks/* from the host are refused
an unmapped tool is blocked and never forwarded (unchanged)
a JSON-RPC batch from the host is rejected (unchanged)
a reply to a method the proxy has no projection for is withheld; the host gets an error

error.message: Aegis: reply to an unrecognized method withheld

cases.doc: initialize keeps the protocol version, known capability flags, serverInfo strings and instructions; everything else is dropped (pinned as projected)
a protocolVersion outside the fixed set becomes an error to the host
an error to an ungated request keeps a fixed code; message is uninspected and data dropped
tools/list shows mapped tools only, spec keys only, hint booleans only; nextCursor becomes a proxy handle that round-trips; an unknown handle is refused (pinned as projected)

no pin file: every server-written interface text is withheld — a tool keeps its policy-known name and an empty object schema, a resource is left out, initialize gets a neutral serverInfo and no instructions; each reply names what it withheld (interface_unapproved)
a pinned entry that the server's projected entry equals is relayed (the pinned value); one that differs (the server changed its description) is withheld and named
pin equality compares numbers by value (2 == 2.0) and never a boolean with a number
uninspected=pass relays an unpinned entry as projected and names it unfiltered (never protected)
resources/list is empty when resources/read is not mapped
resources/list keeps spec keys; a mimeType outside the set is dropped (pinned as projected)
resources/read contents: text through the field rule; the asked URI is kept; another URI is replaced
prompts/get: description uninspected, an unknown role drops the message, free text becomes the notice

content.text: [Aegis: withheld — content could not be checked against purpose 'lookup']

cases.doc: ping / subscribe replies are relayed as an empty result
progress: only a token the host sent; the number is the relay's count (1, 2, ...), never the server's progress or total; message uninspected; unknown token dropped
list_changed is relayed with no params
resources/updated is relayed only for a URI the host subscribed to
a notification the proxy does not recognise is dropped
a server value of an unexpected JSON type (array, object) where a protocol value belongs is treated as outside the set, never looked up as is
a call whose every argument leaf is on the tool's allow list is forwarded unchanged
a leaf off the allow list (a read tool too), a key containing '.', and non-object arguments are refused before anything reaches the server; the event names the arguments, never their values
a tool with no rule is refused (argument_rule_missing), and so is a rule without an allow list
unchecked_arguments=pass forwards a call whose tool has no rule; the reply never says protected and names the arguments unfiltered
